Sebastion “Padre” Ibarra’s closest companion. Judge, jury, and executioner for divine justice - all rolled into one.

Category: V. Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 14 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Pistol Long Barrel, Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load modified Incendiary Ammunition (50eb [Costly] per 10 rounds), which sets damaged targets Strongly on Fire (4 HP damage a Turn) instead of Mildly on Fire and also functions as Armor-Piercing Ammunition.

Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Long Barrel, Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
